chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
There are three things that whoever becomes accustomed to them will not abandon them: trimming the hair, shortening the garment, and marrying bondwomen.

key_terms.اعْتَادَهُنَّ: Became accustomed to them as established habits
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةٌ: Three matters being identified in the saying
key_terms.لَمْ يَدَعْهُنَّ: He does not leave or abandon them

ai.seo_question: What are the three habits that, according to Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام), a person does not easily abandon once accustomed to them?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) states that certain habits, once formed, tend to remain with a person. The hadith identifies personal grooming, dress practice, and marriage to bondwomen as behaviors that become enduring through repeated habit.
